subject: Mutual plan: POC environment blueprint (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial MAP items and timeline for trial POC

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at AcmeHealth is excited to move to a short POC. Before we kick off, our security and infra teams asked for a concise mutual action plan that includes the environment setup items below and an expected close timeline. Can you confirm you can deliver the MAP with timelines for: 

- API key issuance and scoping (ephemeral keys for trial)
- Org setup (tenant creation, service accounts, role bindings)
- IP allowlist and firewall rules (public endpoints)
- VPC peering / routing and shared subnets for the Dedicated test pool

We would like to start the onboarding window the week of May 3rd if that works on your side. Attached is a one-page security checklist we use — happy to share additional context after you send your MAP.

Primary contact here is me (Sara) and I'm cc'ing our onboarding alias.

Best,
Sara Jenkins
Head of Integrations — AcmeHealth
Attachments: acme-security-checklist.pdf
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, onboarding@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP items and timeline for trial POC

Hi Sara — great to hear and thanks for the note. I've drafted a compact MAP below that aligns to your requested items and the May 3rd start window. I'm attaching a slightly opinionated MAP template and a network sketch for your infra team to review.

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Week 0 (Apr 26–30): Align on scope, sign MSA/IO (paperwork), identify Acme infra owners
- Week 1 (May 3–7): Redwood issues trial API keys (ephemeral), Redwood creates Acme tenant and base roles; Acme provides a list of IPs for allowlist
- Week 2 (May 10–14): Test connectivity — IP allowlist applied, basic test requests to hosted endpoint, VPC peering pilot (if Dedicated needed)
- Week 3 (May 17–21): Full end-to-end eval runs, throughput targets validated, cleanup/hand-off notes and close decision

Action items (owners):
- Redwood (Tessa): Share MAP template, create tenant, generate scoped API keys
- Redwood (Ben): Network diagram and peering checklist; lead peering runbook
- Acme (Sara): Confirm infra owner, provide public egress IPs and VPC details, review MAP and sign IO
- Redwood (Neha): Coordinate SOC/infosec evidence and on-call for connectivity window

Next steps:
1) Ben and I will update the attached MAP-template with specific dates for the May window and a short peering checklist.
2) Please confirm the infra contact and a convenient 30-min kickoff slot for May 3 or 4.

I've attached: MAP-template-v2.xlsx (editable) and acme-network-diagram.png (sketch).

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0199
Attachments: MAP-template-v2.xlsx; acme-network-diagram.png
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Actioning Acme MAP — owners and prerequisite checklist (please review)

Team — copying the key notes from Sara's request and my reply. We need to lock down these items by Apr 22 so we can stick to the May 3 kickoff. Please reply inline with ETA.

Quick plan and ask:
- API keys: scoped ephemeral keys for trial, TTL 72h, rate-limited to 10rps. (Owner: Tessa)
- Tenant/org setup: create Acme tenant with 1 admin, 2 service accounts, and RBAC roles for preview and eval. (Owner: Marcus)
- IP allowlist: Acme will provide source IPs; Ben to validate load‑balancer IPs and publish firewall rules. (Owner: Ben)
- VPC peering: Ben to prepare peering checklist; we need expected CIDRs and acceptance window from Acme. If they insist on Dedicated, estimate two-week lead for peering test.
- Security evidence: Neha to prepare SOC2 evidence snippets and retention policy summary for Acme's infosec review.

References included in draft MAP-template (see shared drive link): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_map_onboarding

Ben — can you draft the peering checklist and estimate the ops hours? Marcus — confirm tenant bootstrap script will create the needed service accounts and role bindings. Neha — can you prepare a short packet with the exact logs we can provide and the retention timeline?

Thanks — aim to have updates by Apr 18 so Tessa can finalize MAP with Sara.

—Tessa
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: onboarding@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-14T15:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan: POC environment blueprint (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Thanks Tessa — this looks good and aligned with our expectations. Confirming: May 3 at 10:00am PT for the 30-min kickoff works for our infra lead (I'll add him to the invite). We'll review the MAP-template and return the list of source IPs and VPC CIDRs by Apr 19.

One ask from infosec: can you include a short note in the MAP about key rotation cadence for trial keys and confirmation we can revoke keys immediately if needed? If you add that, we can sign off on the IO this week.

Sara Jenkins
Head of Integrations — AcmeHealth
Attachments: none
